source_data.desc:
This composite creature combines a ruddy-skinned gnome’s upper body and a hell hound’s reddish black body. Stitches and glowing runes where the gnome and hell hound are fused demonstrate the creature’s unnaturalness._  
Infernal centaurs are a response by various cults to the physical might possessed by the centaurs of the nearby plains. Rather than a melding of human and horse, though, these centaurs combine hell-bound gnomes with hell hounds. The composite creature combines gnome cunning with the speed and fiery breath belonging to hell hounds. The ritual that creates an infernal centaur infuses the creature with a peculiar brutality.  
**Unnatural.** Infernal centaurs are not naturally occurring. However, as the ritual to create these centaurs improves and spreads among cults, more gnomes who desire hellish power submit to the ritual, increasing the number of these centaurs.
source_data.name: Infernal Centaur
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Cruelty", "desc": "If the infernal centaur scores a critical hit with a melee attack, it can make a second attack against the same target as a bonus action. It has advantage on this attack roll."}, {"name": "Hell Hound Affinity", "desc": "Hell hounds view infernal centaurs as leaders of their packs. A hell hound refuses to attack an infernal centaur unless the centaur attacks it first. If magically coerced, the hell hound has disadvantage on attack rolls against the centaur. The centaur has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks against hell hounds."}, {"name": "Pack Tactics", "desc": "The centaur has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the centaur's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated."}]

en.description:
This composite creature combines a ruddy-skinned gnome’s upper body and a hell hound’s reddish black body. Stitches and glowing runes where the gnome and hell hound are fused demonstrate the creature’s unnaturalness._  
Infernal centaurs are a response by various cults to the physical might possessed by the centaurs of the nearby plains. Rather than a melding of human and horse, though, these centaurs combine hell-bound gnomes with hell hounds. The composite creature combines gnome cunning with the speed and fiery breath belonging to hell hounds. The ritual that creates an infernal centaur infuses the creature with a peculiar brutality.  
**Unnatural.** Infernal centaurs are not naturally occurring. However, as the ritual to create these centaurs improves and spreads among cults, more gnomes who desire hellish power submit to the ritual, increasing the number of these centaurs.
en.name: Infernal Centaur

ru.description:
Это составное существо объединяет в себе верхнюю тело краснокожего гнома и красновато-чёрное тело адской гончей. Швы и светящиеся руны, где гном и адская гончая сплавлены демонстрируют неестественность существа.

Адские кентавры являются ответом со стороны различных культов на физическую мощь, которой обладают кентавры из близлежащих равнин. Вместо того, чтобы продукт слияния человека и лошади, однако, эти кентавры объединяют адских гномов с адскими гончими. Составное существо сочетает гномьи хитростью со скоростью и огненным дыханием, принадлежащих гончих ада. Ритуал, создающий адский кентавр, наполняет существ своеобразной жестокостью.

**Неестественные.** Инфернальные кентавры не встречаются в природе. Однако, по мере того, как ритуал для создания этих кентавров совершенствуется и распространяется среди культов, все больше гномов, которые желают адской власти, подвергают себя ритуалу, то увеличение числа таких кентавров.
ru.name: Адский кентавр
